systems.system: RURA SAIFI quality-of-service standard (unplanned 15 and planned 10 interruptions per customer per year, low standard)
systems.country_label: Regulatory standard in Regulation 02/R/EL-EWS/RURA/2016, not a measured figure; 15 unplanned and 10 planned interruptions per customer a year at the low standard, lower tiers of 11 and 5 also listed

note: 2016 regulation sets SAIFI/SAIDI reporting and target standards but states no measured outage frequency for Rwanda.
